page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn8is.32xlarge is a GPU-accelerated bare-metal instance featuring 128 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 6462C processors operating at a base frequency of 3.3 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Acceleration is delivered via eight integrated NVIDIA L20 GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, providing a combined total of 384 GB of VRAM.

This instance type does not include local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 170 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers between instances and storage volumes. The KVM hypervisor manages virtualization, ensuring dedicated resource allocation for compute and memory components.

The hardware profile represents a high-density accelerator configuration designed for parallel computing workloads. The combination of eight enterprise-grade GPUs and substantial system memory makes this instance suitable for large-scale deep learning inference, distributed machine learning training, high-fidelity rendering, and complex parallel simulation workloads. The lack of local storage requires architectural planning for data-intensive pipelines to avoid network bottlenecks.
